exams.title: HTML5 & Modern CSS3 Architecture

exams.description: Server Components, Server Actions, React Hooks, streaming SSR with Suspense, routing patterns, and state caching.

exams.description: Stateful/Stateless widgets, Provider/Bloc state management, Dart asynchronous Streams, and native platform channels.

exams.description: Design thinking, user journey mapping, accessibility contrast guidelines, typography scale, and atomic design systems.

exams.description: Comprehensive examination covering HTML5, CSS Grid, Flexbox, responsive web design, and ES6+ JavaScript fundamentals.
